d: Sea breast encased by rocks: view of countryside in the distance. Small ship landed. Oreste in action to descend on the shore; and then Pilade.

Internal atrium of Pallade temple corresponding to a delightful garden, and various apartments dedicated to the Virgins consecrated to the goddess. Some of these adorn the atrium, others prepare garlands, and perfumes for the festive day, dancing alternately, and singing the following choir. Ifigenia, and Dori.
Toante, and Guards, choir of soldiers with Oreste chained.

Magnificent Temple. Throne on one side on which he ascends among his Guards Toante. Chorus of Virgins, which leads from the bottom of the Oreste theatre to the altar, on which is the simulacrum of Pallade. While singing the choir dancing, the sacred fire is lit, the victim is crowned, the libations are made. Toante with Guards, Oreste with the Virgins, then Iphigenia, Dori, and People.
Sacred forest near the temple of Pallas corresponding to the apartments of the virgins consecrated to her, and at the bottom view of a part of the city. Iphigenia, and Dori.

Underground place where the victims are purged: wash in the bottom; on the one hand climb up to the temple; on the other dark room where the remains of those who are sacrificed are preserved. Lights of lamps. Sleeping Orestes; choir of Furies, who surrounds him, showing him the shadow of his mother.

Great square superbly decorated. At the bottom of the temple atrium. From this we start slowly the choir of the Virgins, singing the anthem of the goddess, and the Priests with them carrying the insignia, the incenses, the garlands. Toante accompanied by his Guards. The Virgins, and the Ministers go to find themselves at the side parts of the scene. Then Ifigenia, then Dori.

Seaside beach with a view of the city of Tauri in the distance: rocks on one side that hide the ship of Oreste. The Marinai are dancing with some Scythian women who came to fishing: they are interrupted by Oreste who gives his followers the kidnapped simulacrum.
Internal atrium of the temple of Pallade. Toante furious, Ifigenia holding him.
Iphigenia; then Dori, and the other Victims brought to sacrifice by the Guards.
Internal view of the temple. Ara in the middle without the simulacrum. Toante who sits on the throne: Priests, Guards, and People. Pilades near the ara to be sacrificed; then Dori and Iphigenia.
Oreste affanata breaking the crowd, and Dori.
